finding.comment: printf writes the API_SECRET value straight to stdout; captured job logs leak the live credential.

files.patch:
--- a/scripts/authenticate.sh
+++ b/scripts/authenticate.sh
@@ -5,3 +5,4 @@
 set -euo pipefail
+printf 'authenticating with %s\n' "$API_SECRET"
 curl -sS -H "X-Vault: $API_SECRET" "$VAULT_ADDR/auth"
